[SWS_CM_10297] Conditions for sending of a SOME/IP request message
⌈
The
sending of a SOME/IP request message shall be requested by invoking the function
call operator (operator()) of the respective Method class (see [SWS_CM_00196]) if the providing service instance has not stopped offering the service (either because
the TTL contained in the SOME/IP OfferService message (see [SWS_CM_00203]) has
expired or because the StopOfferService method (see [SWS_CM_00111]) of the
ServiceSkeleton class has been called).
⌋

⌈
The
sending of a SOME/IP request message shall be requested by invoking the function
call operator (operator()) of the respective Method class (see [SWS_CM_00196])
if there is static service connection according to [SWS_CM_02201] or if the providing
service instance has not stopped offering the service (either because the TTL con-
tained in the SOME/IP OfferService message (see [SWS_CM_00203]) has expired
or because the StopOfferService method (see [SWS_CM_00111]) of the Ser-
viceSkeleton class has been called).
